contexts.text: If anyone believes that he is pure from sins... as one who is washed by water... AC 5398:2.
They say that because they have had faith, all evils of life are wiped and washed away by the blood of the Lamb.
Truth is falsified when it is said that sins are wiped and washed away as dirt is with water.
They begin to think as they had done here, that they have been as it were washed from all evil...
Here are water, soap, and a towel... wash thyself. TCR 331, TCR 436:end.
Baptism = spiritual washing, which is a washing from sins.
I washed away thy bloods from upon thee () = to remove the falsities of evil. AE 475:9.
For sins are not washed away and wiped away by water... but they are washed away, that is, removed, by means of truths and a life according to them.
